name: Rumtek Monastery
description: The seat of the Karmapa in Sikkim, Rumtek Monastery is one of the most important Kagyu monasteries in the world. Originally built in the 16th century, it was rebuilt in the 1960s under the guidance of the 16th Karmapa. The monastery houses precious relics and serves as the main seat of the Karma Kagyu lineage.
history: Rumtek Monastery has a rich history dating back to the 16th century when it was first established. The monastery was rebuilt in the 1960s by the 16th Karmapa, Rangjung Rigpe Dorje, who brought many precious relics and texts from Tibet. The monastery serves as the main seat of the Karma Kagyu lineage outside of Tibet and is considered one of the most important Buddhist institutions in the world.
architecture: The monastery features traditional Tibetan architecture with a golden stupa, intricate murals, and beautiful courtyards. The main prayer hall is adorned with traditional thangkas and houses a magnificent golden stupa containing relics of the 16th Karmapa. The monastery complex includes residential quarters for monks, a library, and meditation halls.
practices: Rumtek Monastery follows the Karma Kagyu tradition, emphasizing meditation practices, particularly Mahamudra. The monastery conducts daily prayers, special ceremonies, and annual festivals including the Tibetan New Year celebrations. Monks engage in intensive study of Buddhist philosophy and meditation practices.
significance: Rumtek is the seat of the Karmapa, one of the most important figures in Tibetan Buddhism. The monastery houses the Karmapa's Black Crown and other precious relics. It serves as a center for the preservation and transmission of the Karma Kagyu teachings.

audioGuide.en: Welcome to Rumtek Monastery, the sacred seat of the Karmapa in Sikkim. This magnificent monastery represents the heart of the Karma Kagyu tradition, housing precious relics and serving as a center for Buddhist learning and meditation.
audioGuide.hi: रुमटेक मठ में आपका स्वागत है, सिक्किम में कर्मापा का पवित्र स्थान। यह शानदार मठ कर्म काग्यू परंपरा के केंद्र का प्रतिनिधित्व करता है।
audioGuide.ne: रुमटेक मठमा स्वागत छ, सिक्किममा कर्मापाको पवित्र स्थान। यो शानदार मठ कर्म काग्यू परम्पराको केन्द्र हो।

name: Pemayangtse Monastery
description: One of the oldest and most important Nyingma monasteries in Sikkim, Pemayangtse Monastery is renowned for its Sangtok Pelri model, a three-dimensional representation of Guru Padmasambhava's celestial palace. The monastery offers breathtaking views of the Kanchenjunga mountain range.
history: Founded in the 17th century by Lhatsun Chempo, a revered Nyingma lama, Pemayangtse Monastery has been a center of Nyingma teachings for centuries. The monastery was built on a site blessed by Guru Padmasambhava and has played a crucial role in preserving the Nyingma tradition in Sikkim.
architecture: The monastery features traditional Nyingma architecture with wooden structures, intricate carvings, and ancient murals. The most famous feature is the Sangtok Pelri model, a three-story structure representing Guru Padmasambhava's celestial palace, complete with detailed sculptures and paintings.
practices: Pemayangtse follows the Nyingma tradition, emphasizing the teachings of Guru Padmasambhava and the practice of Dzogchen. The monastery conducts daily prayers, meditation sessions, and special ceremonies. Monks engage in the study of Nyingma texts and practices.
significance: Pemayangtse is considered one of the most sacred Nyingma monasteries in Sikkim. The Sangtok Pelri model is a unique masterpiece of Buddhist art and architecture, representing the pure land of Guru Padmasambhava.

audioGuide.en: Welcome to Pemayangtse Monastery, one of the oldest Nyingma monasteries in Sikkim. This sacred site is famous for its Sangtok Pelri model, a three-dimensional representation of Guru Padmasambhava's celestial palace.
audioGuide.hi: पेमायंगत्से मठ में आपका स्वागत है, सिक्किम के सबसे पुराने न्यिंगमा मठों में से एक। यह पवित्र स्थान अपने संगतोक पेलरी मॉडल के लिए प्रसिद्ध है।
audioGuide.ne: पेमायंगत्से मठमा स्वागत छ, सिक्किमको सबैभन्दा पुरानो न्यिंगमा मठ। यो पवित्र स्थान संगतोक पेलरी मॉडलका लागि प्रसिद्ध छ।

name: Tashiding Monastery
description: A sacred Nyingma monastery perched on a hilltop, Tashiding is renowned for its Bhumchu festival and spiritual significance. The monastery offers panoramic views of the surrounding valleys and is considered one of the most sacred sites in Sikkim.
history: Tashiding Monastery was established in the 17th century and is associated with Guru Padmasambhava's blessings. The monastery has been a center of Nyingma teachings and practices for centuries, attracting pilgrims from across the region.
architecture: The monastery features traditional Tibetan architecture with white-washed walls, golden roofs, and prayer flags. The complex includes the main prayer hall, residential quarters, and several chortens (stupas) scattered around the hillside.
practices: Tashiding follows the Nyingma tradition with emphasis on Guru Padmasambhava's teachings. The monastery is famous for its Bhumchu ceremony, where sacred water is used to predict the year's fortunes. Daily prayers and meditation sessions are conducted regularly.
significance: Tashiding is considered one of the most sacred monasteries in Sikkim, blessed by Guru Padmasambhava. The Bhumchu festival is a major cultural event that attracts thousands of devotees annually.

audioGuide.en: Welcome to Tashiding Monastery, a sacred Nyingma monastery known for its Bhumchu festival and spiritual significance. This hilltop monastery offers breathtaking views and is considered one of the most sacred sites in Sikkim.
audioGuide.hi: ताशीडिंग मठ में आपका स्वागत है, एक पवित्र न्यिंगमा मठ जो अपने भूमचु त्योहार के लिए प्रसिद्ध है। यह पहाड़ी मठ सिक्किम के सबसे पवित्र स्थानों में से एक है।
audioGuide.ne: ताशीडिंग मठमा स्वागत छ, एक पवित्र न्यिंगमा मठ जुन आफ्नो भूमचु उत्सवका लागि प्रसिद्ध छ। यो पहाडी मठ सिक्किमको सबैभन्दा पवित्र स्थानहरू मध्ये एक हो।

name: Enchey Monastery
description: Located in Gangtok, Enchey Monastery is a beautiful Nyingma monastery known for its annual Chaam dance festival. The monastery offers stunning views of the city and surrounding mountains.
history: Enchey Monastery was built in the 19th century and is associated with the Nyingma tradition. The monastery has been a center of Buddhist learning and practice in Gangtok, serving the local community and visitors.
architecture: The monastery features traditional Tibetan architecture with colorful decorations, prayer wheels, and beautiful murals. The main prayer hall houses important Buddhist texts and statues.
practices: Enchey follows the Nyingma tradition with daily prayers and meditation sessions. The monastery is famous for its annual Chaam dance festival, which attracts visitors from around the world.
significance: Enchey Monastery is an important religious and cultural center in Gangtok, serving as a place of worship and learning for the local Buddhist community.

audioGuide.en: Welcome to Enchey Monastery in Gangtok, a beautiful Nyingma monastery known for its annual Chaam dance festival and stunning mountain views.
audioGuide.hi: गंगटोक में एंचे मठ में आपका स्वागत है, एक सुंदर न्यिंगमा मठ जो अपने वार्षिक चाम नृत्य उत्सव के लिए प्रसिद्ध है।
audioGuide.ne: गंगटोकमा एंचे मठमा स्वागत छ, एक सुन्दर न्यिंगमा मठ जुन आफ्नो वार्षिक चाम नृत्य उत्सवका लागि प्रसिद्ध छ।

history: Phodong Monastery was established in the 18th century and has been a center of Kagyu teachings in North Sikkim. The monastery has played an important role in preserving Buddhist culture in the region.
architecture: The monastery features traditional Kagyu architecture with prayer halls, residential quarters, and beautiful gardens. The main prayer hall is adorned with traditional thangkas and statues.
practices: Phodong follows the Kagyu tradition with emphasis on meditation and study. The monastery conducts daily prayers and special ceremonies throughout the year.
significance: Phodong Monastery is an important religious center in North Sikkim, serving the local Buddhist community and preserving traditional Kagyu teachings.

audioGuide.en: Welcome to Phodong Monastery, a peaceful Kagyu monastery in North Sikkim known for its traditional architecture and serene atmosphere.

audioGuide.en: Welcome to Labrang Monastery, a Gelug monastery known for its scholarly tradition and beautiful architecture in East Sikkim.

name: Sakya Monastery
description: A Sakya monastery in South Sikkim, Sakya Monastery is known for its unique Sakya tradition and beautiful architecture. The monastery serves as a center for Sakya teachings and practices.
history: Sakya Monastery was established in the 18th century and has been a center of Sakya teachings in South Sikkim. The monastery has played an important role in preserving the Sakya tradition.
architecture: The monastery features traditional Sakya architecture with prayer halls, residential quarters, and beautiful gardens. The main prayer hall is adorned with traditional Sakya thangkas and statues.
practices: Sakya follows the Sakya tradition with emphasis on Lamdre teachings and meditation. The monastery conducts daily prayers and special ceremonies throughout the year.
significance: Sakya Monastery is an important religious center in South Sikkim, serving the local Sakya community and preserving traditional Sakya teachings.
